title: Cleaning Charges Added to a Challenged Amount on Car Hire
content:
A cleaning charge standing on the ledger of a rental booked under the Car Rental Rate Classes may be added
to the amount the renter puts in dispute. What decides how much of it is added is the included mileage still unused on that
rental.

| What the rental shows | Added for cleaning |
| --- | --- |
| the ledger carries a cleaning charge and the included mileage still unused on the rental is nothing or more | the whole of that cleaning charge |
| the ledger carries a cleaning charge | 50 per cent of that cleaning charge |
| the ledger carries no cleaning charge | nothing |

Where the ledger carries a cleaning charge on the rental and the included mileage still unused on the rental
is nothing or more, the whole of that cleaning charge is added. Where the ledger carries a cleaning charge
on the rental, 50 per cent of it is added. Where the ledger carries no cleaning charge on the rental,
nothing is added for cleaning.

## Where the mileage mark is satisfied

The rows are taken in the order they stand, so the second answers only those rentals the first does not: a
rental carrying a cleaning charge whose included mileage still unused stands below nothing.

The mileage mark is satisfied at nothing exactly as well as above it. A rental that used its allowance to
the last mile, leaving nothing unused, falls in the first row; only a rental that has run past its allowance
falls in the second.

## A cleaning charge worked through

A rental whose ledger carries a cleaning charge of 125 USD, having 40 miles of its included allowance still
unused: the whole 125 USD is added. The same rental having run 40 miles past its allowance: 50 per cent of
125 USD, which is 62.50 USD, is added.
